correctness.rationale: For each edge uv of sign s=+1(red)/-1(blue), exactly d-1 adjacent red edges is equivalent to R(u)+R(v)-d=s, i.e. f(u)+f(v)=s for f=R-d/2. Summing over incident edges yields Af=-(d-2)f. Walsh diagonalization of Q_d confines f to co-singleton characters, and the unit edge signs force each coefficient to be epsilon_i/2. Thus every colouring has the unique asserted direction-parity form; conversely, toggling direction i reverses the two adjacent direction-j edge signs for each j!=i, proving sufficiency. Exactly 2^d named assignments, 2^(d-1) up to colour exchange; index 2, for all d>=4. Independently enumerated all 2^4 and 2^12 candidate edge assignments in dimensions 2 and 3 and recovered 4 and 8 legal assignments; the general proof is spectral, not enumeration.
